about: Indirect-fire cadence, range and spread for turn-based play (SPEC §10). A class fires one volley every usage_turns turns. Shells per volley = CoH3 damage rate over that time ÷ CoH3 damage per shell, rounded up; accuracy carries the rounding. Range = CoH3 metres ÷ 7, capped. Each shell lands on a random hex within spread_hex of the aimed hex (0 = the aimed hex). Classes match weapon / ability / squad ids by pattern, first match wins.
